name: Gold Token
oneLiner: GLDT is Gold DAO's fungible gold token: each token represents 0.01 grams of physical gold through locked GLD NFT backing.
collateral: GLD NFTs representing physical gold bars stored in Swiss vaults; GLDT is minted when GLD NFTs are locked in the swap canister at a ratio of 1 gram of GLD NFT backing for 100 GLDT
pegMechanism: Commodity redemption/swap model: 1 GLDT represents 0.01 grams of gold, and GLDT can be reverse-swapped into GLD NFTs when enough tokens are supplied to unlock the corresponding NFT denomination

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: GLDT references physical gold through the GLD NFT deed structure, so it belongs with the direct commodity claims rather than with fiat-cash. The archetype placement is not an endorsement of the claim: Gold DAO's binding terms expressly state that GLDT is not legal ownership of gold and that Gold DAO does not guarantee redemption or conversion, and a holder must first reverse-swap GLDT into a GLD NFT, which alone is described as a deed to a bar. Migrated under methodology v9.14; that documented disclaimer is graded in the commodity components, where the September 2025 KPMG factual-findings report naming Loomis Schweiz AG, Kloten anchors custody.

sources.label: Gold DAO binding terms of service

proofOfReserves.provider: KPMG SA Neuchatel (Swiss Auditing Standard 920 reports of factual findings, expressly neither an audit nor a review, restricted use; reconciles 7.9kg gold at Loomis to GLD NFT certificates of Bity Tokenisation SA - not to GLDT token supply - sampling 100 of 790 serials; newest report periodEnd 2025-09-21, published 2025-10-02, series stalled ~10.5 months against the claimed cycle; gldt.org itself hosts no artefact)

latestReport.reviewer: PoR verification sweep 2026-08 (PDF read: Swiss AS 920 factual findings, no assurance expressed; reconciles gold to GLD NFT certificates, not GLDT supply; newest artefact in a stalled series)
